<?php
/**
 * Front-end markup processing for core media blocks.
 *
 * All changes are applied on the `render_block_{$name}` filters, so only the
 * HTML sent to visitors changes. Saved post content is never modified.
 *
 * HTML is read and modified exclusively with the WordPress HTML API
 * (WP_HTML_Tag_Processor). No regular expressions, no DOMDocument.
 *
 * @package SmartMediaMarkup
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Class Smart_Media_Markup
 */
class Smart_Media_Markup {

	/**
	 * Blocks whose rendered output is processed.
	 *
	 * @var string[]
	 */
	const BLOCKS = array( 'core/image', 'core/gallery', 'core/cover' );

	/**
	 * Class added to the block wrapper element.
	 *
	 * @var string
	 */
	const WRAPPER_CLASS = 'has-smart-media';

	/**
	 * Image block attribute controlling "Use caption as alt text".
	 *
	 * @var string
	 */
	const CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE = 'smartMediaCaptionAsAlt';

	/**
	 * Script handle for the editor extension.
	 *
	 * @var string
	 */
	const EDITOR_HANDLE = 'smart-media-markup-editor';

	/**
	 * Cached, lower-cased host of the site.
	 *
	 * @var string|null
	 */
	private static $site_host = null;

	/**
	 * Registers hooks.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function init() {
		foreach ( self::BLOCKS as $block_name ) {
			add_filter( "render_block_{$block_name}", array( __CLASS__, 'filter_block' ), 10, 2 );
		}

		add_filter( 'register_block_type_args', array( __CLASS__, 'register_attribute' ), 10, 2 );
		add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', array( __CLASS__, 'enqueue_editor_assets' ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the caption-as-alt attribute on the server for core/image.
	 *
	 * @param array  $args       Block type arguments.
	 * @param string $block_type Block type name.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function register_attribute( $args, $block_type ) {
		if ( 'core/image' !== $block_type ) {
			return $args;
		}

		if ( ! isset( $args['attributes'] ) || ! is_array( $args['attributes'] ) ) {
			$args['attributes'] = array();
		}

		$args['attributes'][ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] = array(
			'type'    => 'boolean',
			'default' => false,
		);

		return $args;
	}

	/**
	 * Enqueues the block editor extension (sidebar toggle).
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function enqueue_editor_assets() {
		$asset_file = SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_DIR . 'build/index.asset.php';

		if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$asset = include $asset_file;

		wp_enqueue_script(
			self::EDITOR_HANDLE,
			plugins_url( 'build/index.js', SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_FILE ),
			isset( $asset['dependencies'] ) ? $asset['dependencies'] : array(),
			isset( $asset['version'] ) ? $asset['version'] : false,
			true
		);

		wp_set_script_translations( self::EDITOR_HANDLE, 'smart-media-markup' );
	}

	/**
	 * Filters the rendered HTML of a supported block.
	 *
	 * @param string $block_content Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $block         Parsed block.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function filter_block( $block_content, $block ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $block_content ) || '' === trim( $block_content ) ) {
			return $block_content;
		}

		$caption_alt = '';

		if (
			isset( $block['blockName'] ) &&
			'core/image' === $block['blockName'] &&
			! empty( $block['attrs'][ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] )
		) {
			$caption_alt = self::get_caption_text( $block_content );
		}

		return self::process( $block_content, $caption_alt );
	}

	/**
	 * Applies all markup improvements to a block's HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html        Block HTML.
	 * @param string $caption_alt Plain-text alt to use for images without alt text. Empty to skip.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function process( $html, $caption_alt = '' ) {
		$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$is_first  = true;

		// next_tag() only visits opening tags by default.
		while ( $processor->next_tag() ) {
			if ( $is_first ) {
				$is_first = false;
				$processor->add_class( self::WRAPPER_CLASS );
			}

			$tag = $processor->get_tag();

			if ( 'IMG' === $tag ) {
				self::process_image( $processor, $caption_alt );
			} elseif ( 'A' === $tag ) {
				self::process_link( $processor );
			}
		}

		return $processor->get_updated_html();
	}

	/**
	 * Adds async decoding and, if requested, caption-based alt text to an IMG.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor   Processor positioned on an IMG tag.
	 * @param string                $caption_alt Alt text from caption, or empty string.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_image( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor, $caption_alt ) {
		// Respect any existing decoding mode (including a bare attribute).
		if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'decoding' ) ) {
			$processor->set_attribute( 'decoding', 'async' );
		}

		if ( '' === $caption_alt ) {
			return;
		}

		$alt = $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' );

		if ( null === $alt || true === $alt || '' === trim( $alt ) ) {
			// set_attribute() escapes the value.
			$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $caption_alt );
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Adds rel="noopener" to links pointing to another site, keeping existing rel values.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor Processor positioned on an A tag.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_link( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor ) {
		$href = $processor->get_attribute( 'href' );

		if ( ! is_string( $href ) || ! self::is_external_url( $href ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$rel    = $processor->get_attribute( 'rel' );
		$tokens = is_string( $rel ) ? self::split_tokens( $rel ) : array();

		foreach ( $tokens as $token ) {
			if ( 'noopener' === strtolower( $token ) ) {
				return;
			}
		}

		$tokens[] = 'noopener';

		$processor->set_attribute( 'rel', implode( ' ', $tokens ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Determines whether a URL points to another site.
	 *
	 * @param string $url URL from an href attribute.
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public static function is_external_url( $url ) {
		$url      = trim( $url );
		$external = false;

		if ( '' !== $url ) {
			$parts = wp_parse_url( $url );

			if ( is_array( $parts ) && ! empty( $parts['host'] ) ) {
				$scheme = isset( $parts['scheme'] ) ? strtolower( $parts['scheme'] ) : '';

				// Relative-scheme (//host) URLs have no scheme; only http(s) links are web pages.
				if ( '' === $scheme || 'http' === $scheme || 'https' === $scheme ) {
					$external = strtolower( $parts['host'] ) !== self::get_site_host();
				}
			}
		}

		/**
		 * Filters whether a link inside a media block is treated as external.
		 *
		 * @param bool   $external Whether the URL points to another site.
		 * @param string $url      The link URL.
		 */
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'smart_media_markup_is_external_url', $external, $url );
	}

	/**
	 * Extracts the plain text of the first FIGCAPTION in the HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Plain text (unescaped), whitespace-normalized.
	 */
	public static function get_caption_text( $html ) {
		$processor  = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$in_caption = false;
		$text       = '';

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $type ) {
				$tag = $processor->get_tag();

				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag ) {
					if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
						if ( $in_caption ) {
							break;
						}
					} else {
						$in_caption = true;
					}
					continue;
				}

				if ( $in_caption && 'BR' === $tag ) {
					$text .= ' ';
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $in_caption && '#text' === $type ) {
				// Text nodes are returned with character references decoded.
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		return implode( ' ', self::split_tokens( $text ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Splits a string on ASCII whitespace, dropping empty pieces.
	 *
	 * @param string $value Input string.
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	private static function split_tokens( $value ) {
		$normalized = strtr( $value, "\t\n\r\f", '    ' );

		return array_values(
			array_filter(
				explode( ' ', $normalized ),
				static function ( $piece ) {
					return '' !== $piece;
				}
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the lower-cased host of the site's home URL.
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function get_site_host() {
		if ( null === self::$site_host ) {
			$host            = wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST );
			self::$site_host = is_string( $host ) ? strtolower( $host ) : '';
		}

		return self::$site_host;
	}
}

	 *
	 * @param array  $args       Block type arguments.
	 * @param string $block_type Block type name.
	 * @return array
	 */
	public static function register_attribute( $args, $block_type ) {
		if ( 'core/image' !== $block_type ) {
			return $args;
		}

		if ( ! isset( $args['attributes'] ) || ! is_array( $args['attributes'] ) ) {
			$args['attributes'] = array();
		}

		$args['attributes'][ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] = array(
			'type'    => 'boolean',
			'default' => false,
		);

		return $args;
	}

	/**
	 * Enqueues the block editor extension (sidebar toggle).
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public static function enqueue_editor_assets() {
		$asset_file = SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_DIR . 'build/index.asset.php';

		if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$asset = include $asset_file;

		wp_enqueue_script(
			self::EDITOR_HANDLE,
			plugins_url( 'build/index.js', SMART_MEDIA_MARKUP_FILE ),
			isset( $asset['dependencies'] ) ? $asset['dependencies'] : array(),
			isset( $asset['version'] ) ? $asset['version'] : false,
			true
		);

		wp_set_script_translations( self::EDITOR_HANDLE, 'smart-media-markup' );
	}

	/**
	 * Filters the rendered HTML of a supported block.
	 *
	 * @param string $block_content Rendered block HTML.
	 * @param array  $block         Parsed block.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function filter_block( $block_content, $block ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $block_content ) || '' === trim( $block_content ) ) {
			return $block_content;
		}

		$caption_alt = '';

		if (
			isset( $block['blockName'] ) &&
			'core/image' === $block['blockName'] &&
			! empty( $block['attrs'][ self::CAPTION_ALT_ATTRIBUTE ] )
		) {
			$caption_alt = self::get_caption_text( $block_content );
		}

		return self::process( $block_content, $caption_alt );
	}

	/**
	 * Applies all markup improvements to a block's HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html        Block HTML.
	 * @param string $caption_alt Plain-text alt to use for images without alt text. Empty to skip.
	 * @return string
	 */
	public static function process( $html, $caption_alt = '' ) {
		$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$is_first  = true;

		// next_tag() only visits opening tags by default.
		while ( $processor->next_tag() ) {
			if ( $is_first ) {
				$is_first = false;
				$processor->add_class( self::WRAPPER_CLASS );
			}

			$tag = $processor->get_tag();

			if ( 'IMG' === $tag ) {
				self::process_image( $processor, $caption_alt );
			} elseif ( 'A' === $tag ) {
				self::process_link( $processor );
			}
		}

		return $processor->get_updated_html();
	}

	/**
	 * Adds async decoding and, if requested, caption-based alt text to an IMG.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor   Processor positioned on an IMG tag.
	 * @param string                $caption_alt Alt text from caption, or empty string.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_image( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor, $caption_alt ) {
		// Respect any existing decoding mode (including a bare attribute).
		if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'decoding' ) ) {
			$processor->set_attribute( 'decoding', 'async' );
		}

		if ( '' === $caption_alt ) {
			return;
		}

		$alt = $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' );

		if ( null === $alt || true === $alt || '' === trim( $alt ) ) {
			// set_attribute() escapes the value.
			$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', $caption_alt );
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Adds rel="noopener" to links pointing to another site, keeping existing rel values.
	 *
	 * @param WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor Processor positioned on an A tag.
	 * @return void
	 */
	private static function process_link( WP_HTML_Tag_Processor $processor ) {
		$href = $processor->get_attribute( 'href' );

		if ( ! is_string( $href ) || ! self::is_external_url( $href ) ) {
			return;
		}

		$rel    = $processor->get_attribute( 'rel' );
		$tokens = is_string( $rel ) ? self::split_tokens( $rel ) : array();

		foreach ( $tokens as $token ) {
			if ( 'noopener' === strtolower( $token ) ) {
				return;
			}
		}

		$tokens[] = 'noopener';

		$processor->set_attribute( 'rel', implode( ' ', $tokens ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Determines whether a URL points to another site.
	 *
	 * @param string $url URL from an href attribute.
	 * @return bool
	 */
	public static function is_external_url( $url ) {
		$url      = trim( $url );
		$external = false;

		if ( '' !== $url ) {
			$parts = wp_parse_url( $url );

			if ( is_array( $parts ) && ! empty( $parts['host'] ) ) {
				$scheme = isset( $parts['scheme'] ) ? strtolower( $parts['scheme'] ) : '';

				// Relative-scheme (//host) URLs have no scheme; only http(s) links are web pages.
				if ( '' === $scheme || 'http' === $scheme || 'https' === $scheme ) {
					$external = strtolower( $parts['host'] ) !== self::get_site_host();
				}
			}
		}

		/**
		 * Filters whether a link inside a media block is treated as external.
		 *
		 * @param bool   $external Whether the URL points to another site.
		 * @param string $url      The link URL.
		 */
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'smart_media_markup_is_external_url', $external, $url );
	}

	/**
	 * Extracts the plain text of the first FIGCAPTION in the HTML.
	 *
	 * @param string $html Block HTML.
	 * @return string Plain text (unescaped), whitespace-normalized.
	 */
	public static function get_caption_text( $html ) {
		$processor  = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
		$in_caption = false;
		$text       = '';

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $type ) {
				$tag = $processor->get_tag();

				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag ) {
					if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
						if ( $in_caption ) {
							break;
						}
					} else {
						$in_caption = true;
					}
					continue;
				}

				if ( $in_caption && 'BR' === $tag ) {
					$text .= ' ';
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $in_caption && '#text' === $type ) {
				// Text nodes are returned with character references decoded.
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		return implode( ' ', self::split_tokens( $text ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Splits a string on ASCII whitespace, dropping empty pieces.
	 *
	 * @param string $value Input string.
	 * @return string[]
	 */
	private static function split_tokens( $value ) {
		$normalized = strtr( $value, "\t\n\r\f", '    ' );

		return array_values(
			array_filter(
				explode( ' ', $normalized ),
				static function ( $piece ) {
					return '' !== $piece;
				}
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the lower-cased host of the site's home URL.
	 *
	 * @return string
	 */
	private static function get_site_host() {
		if ( null === self::$site_host ) {
			$host            = wp_parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST );
			self::$site_host = is_string( $host ) ? strtolower( $host ) : '';
		}

		return self::$site_host;
	}
}

=== Smart Media Markup ===
Contributors: smartmediamarkup

Improves the front-end HTML of the core Image, Gallery and Cover blocks.

== Description ==

Only the HTML sent to visitors changes; saved post content is never modified.
All changes use the WordPress HTML API (WP_HTML_Tag_Processor).

* Images get `decoding="async"` unless they already set a decoding mode.
* The block wrapper element (the outer figure; for Cover, its outer div) gets the class `has-smart-media`.
* Links to other sites get `rel="noopener"`, keeping any existing `rel` values.
* Image block: "Use caption as alt text" toggle. When on and the image has no alt text, the caption's plain text is used as alt text.

Filter `smart_media_markup_is_external_url( bool $external, string $url )` changes how links are classified.

== Development ==

`npm install && npm run build` builds the editor script into `build/`.
Tests: `tests/fixtures/` holds input/expected HTML pairs; `tests/test-smart-media-markup.php` runs them with the WordPress PHPUnit test suite.

I've built the Smart Media Markup plugin. Nothing has been run: shell commands were off-limits, so there's no `npm install`, no build, and I haven't run the PHPUnit tests. The editor toggle needs `npm install && npm run build` before it shows up. Until then, the plugin skips the editor script without erroring. How it works: - **Parser:** all HTML is read and changed with `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor`, the HTML parser that ships with WordPress. There are no regular expressions and no DOMDocument. - **Visitors only:** the changes are made on the `render_block_core/image`, `render_block_core/gallery` and `render_block_core/cover` filters. Saved post content isn't touched, and one test checks that. - **WordPress version:** it needs 6.5 or later. Getting the caption's plain text uses `next_token()` and `get_modifiable_text()`, which arrived in 6.5. What each change does: 1. **Async decoding:** images get `decoding="async"` only if they have no `decoding` attribute at all. An existing `decoding="sync"` is left alone. 2. **The `has-smart-media` class:** it goes on the block's outermost element. The Cover block's outer element is a `div`, not a `figure`, so the class goes on that `div`. 3. **External links:** these get `rel="noopener"` added after any `rel` values already there. A link counts as external when its host differs from the site's home URL host. Relative links, `#anchors` and `mailto:` links are left alone, and links that already have `noopener` aren't changed. You can change what counts as external with the `smart_media_markup_is_external_url` filter. 4. **Caption as alt text:** the toggle stores a setting called `smartMediaCaptionAsAlt` on the Image block. Like any block setting, it is saved in the block comment in post content when switched on. When it's on and the alt text is empty, the caption's plain text becomes the alt: tags are stripped, `
` becomes a space and entities are decoded. Two things to check: - **Images inside a Gallery** are processed twice: once as Image blocks, then again inside the Gallery's HTML. The result is the same either way, and there's a test for that. - **Exact expected outputs:** the fixtures assume the parser puts new attributes straight after the tag name (e.g. ``) and escapes `&` as `&`. If a WordPress version formats either differently, those exact-match tests will fail even though the behaviour is correct. Files are in `./output/smart-media-markup/`: - `smart-media-markup.php` – main plugin file - `includes/class-smart-media-markup.php` – the HTML changes, the Image block setting, and loading the editor script - `src/index.js` – the editor sidebar toggle - `package.json` – uses `@wordpress/scripts` - `readme.txt` - `phpunit.xml.dist` - `tests/bootstrap.php` - `tests/test-smart-media-markup.php` – runs each fixture, checks that running twice gives the same result, that saved content is unchanged, and that caption text is extracted correctly - `tests/fixtures/` – an input and expected-output HTML pair for each case: - `image-decoding-async` - `image-decoding-existing` - `gallery-wrapper-class` - `cover-block` - `external-links` - `caption-alt-enabled` - `caption-alt-existing-alt` - `caption-alt-disabled`
